# cloudterm

Install: `npm i cloudterm` (`bun add cloudterm`, `pnpm add cloudterm`).

A CSS import and explicitly sized host are required.

index.html:
```html
<div id="terminal" style="width: 800px; height: 400px"></div>
<script type="module" src="/main.js"></script>
```

main.js:
```js
import { mount } from 'cloudterm';
import 'cloudterm/style.css';
const decoder = new TextDecoder();
const term = await mount(document.querySelector('#terminal'), {
  onData(bytes) { console.log(decoder.decode(bytes)); },
});
term.write('ready\r\n');
term.focus();
```

`onData` receives a `Uint8Array`. Decode it before sending text to a transport.

API:
```ts
interface Theme {
  background: string; foreground: string; cursor: string;
  fontFamily: string; fontSize: number;
}
interface SearchOptions { caseSensitive?: boolean; regex?: boolean; }
interface SearchMatch { line: number; col: number; length: number; }
interface MountOptions {
  onData: (data: Uint8Array) => void;
  onResize?: (cols: number, rows: number) => void;
  onTitle?: (title: string) => void;
  onCwd?: (uri: string) => void;
  onClipboard?: (text: string, selection: string) => void;
  theme?: Partial<Theme>; maxScrollback?: number;
  predictionMode?: 'off' | 'auto';
}
interface Terminal {
  write(data: string | Uint8Array): void; fit(): void; focus(): void; destroy(): void;
  search(query: string, opts?: SearchOptions): SearchMatch[];
  findNext(query: string, opts?: SearchOptions): SearchMatch | null;
  findPrevious(query: string, opts?: SearchOptions): SearchMatch | null;
  clearSearch(): void; serialize(): string; restore(data: string): void;
  readonly cols: number; readonly rows: number;
}
declare function mount(el: HTMLElement, opts: MountOptions): Promise<Terminal>;
export { MountOptions, type SearchMatch, type SearchOptions, Terminal, type Theme, mount };
```
